target_concept: Trace the outer‑loop/inner‑loop flow that processes characters up to the smallest length and breaks on mismatch

mcq.questionText: According to the evidence, at what point does the break statement cause the algorithm to exit the loops?
options: As soon as a mismatch is found between characters at the same index in any two strings.
After all characters of the longest string have been processed.
Only after the inner loop finishes iterating over all three strings for a given index.
When the hash set reaches a size of three.
mcq.correctAnswer: As soon as a mismatch is found between characters at the same index in any two strings.
mcq.explanation: The evidence states that the inner loop processes one character from each of the three strings at a given index, and "if the size is one, it means it is repeating in all. Otherwise, we break. Where does the break take you out of? Out of each loop". This indicates the break occurs immediately when a character mismatch is detected, exiting both loops.
